test_draw_dataset_dict: test the Visualizer to draw bounding boxes and segmentation masks from a COCO-style dataset dictionary
test_overlay_instances: test overlaying instance masks, boxes, and labels on an image with optional scaling
test_draw_instance_predictions: test drawing instance prediction results including classes, scores, boxes, and masks on an image
test_draw_binary_mask: test drawing a binary mask with a specified color and optional text label on an image
test_draw_soft_mask: test drawing a soft probability mask with Gaussian blur and a specified color on an image
